turns.reply:
Your product HG-023 "CBD Infused Lavender Relaxation Candle, 6 oz" was disapproved because Google's healthcare policy places cannabidiol (CBD) on its list of unapproved pharmaceuticals and supplements. Products containing or mentioning CBD are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings ([CBD and other unapproved substances](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6165956)).

This is a policy restriction rather than a data entry issue, so editing the product text won't resolve it. If you believe this product was flagged in error, an appeal can be submitted ([Requesting a review or appealing a decision](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13585221)). Please let me know if you want to proceed with an appeal or if you would like to review the other product issues in your store.
